# Micah 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Now gather-yourself-in-troops, daughter-of troops; siege he-has-laid against-us; with-a-rod they-strike upon-the-cheek the-judge-of Israel.

**2** And-you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, [too]-small to-be among-the-clans-of Judah, from-you to-Me will-come-forth [one]-to-be ruler in-Israel, and-his-goings-forth [are] from-of-old, from-days-of eternity.

**3** Therefore He-will-give-them-up until [the]-time a-woman-in-labor has-given-birth; then-the-rest-of his-brothers will-return to the-sons-of Israel.

**4** And-he-will-stand and-shepherd in-the-strength-of YHWH, in-the-majesty-of the-name-of YHWH his-God; and-they-will-dwell, for now he-will-be-great to-the-ends-of the-earth.

**5** And-this-[one] will-be peace. When Assyria comes into-our-land and-when he-treads in-our-palaces, then-we-will-raise against-him seven shepherds and-eight princes-of men.

**6** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**7** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**8** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**9** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**10** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**11** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**12** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**13** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**14** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

**15** And-the-remnant-of Jacob will-be in-the-midst-of many peoples like-dew from-YHWH, like-showers upon grass, which does-not-wait for-man and-does-not-delay for-the-sons-of men.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **5:2**: U-motza'otav mi-qedem, mi-ymei olam — 'his goings forth from of old, from days of eternity.' The ruler's origins are pre-historical. The language (olam) pushes beyond time into the eternal.

- **5:2**: Bethlehem Ephrathah — David's birthplace (1 Sam 17:12). The specification 'Ephrathah' distinguishes it from Bethlehem in Zebulun. The insignificant village becomes the source of cosmic kingship.

- **5:4**: Ve-ra'ah be-oz YHWH — 'He will shepherd in the strength of YHWH.' The messianic ruler combines royal and pastoral imagery — king as shepherd, governing with divine power.

— EMET
